test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Ministries conferred the prestigious National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Awards in 2025 for distinguished practitioners for their exceptional contributions to the field of traditional Indian medicine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of AYUSH**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Awards** are conferred annually by the **Ministry of AYUSH**, Government of India, to recognize eminent practitioners and institutions for their outstanding contributions to **Ayurveda**.
 
• In **2025**, these awards continued to highlight the government's commitment to promoting **traditional Indian medicine** on both national and global platforms.
 
• The award ceremony is typically held on **Ayurveda Day**, which is celebrated every year on the occasion of **Dhanwantari Jayanti** (Dhanteras).
 
• The award includes a **citation**, a **trophy**, and a **cash prize** of **Rs. 5 lakh**, making it one of the most prestigious honors in the field of traditional medicine. ***Hence, the correct answer is the Ministry of AYUSH.***
 
• The primary objective of these awards is to encourage **research**, **clinical excellence**, and the **propagation** of Ayurvedic principles to improve public health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of AYUSH:** 
 
 
• The ministry was formed on **9th November 2014** to ensure the optimal development and propagation of AYUSH systems of healthcare.
 
• It covers **Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy**.
 
• The ministry plays a vital role in the **National AYUSH Mission (NAM)**, which aims to provide cost-effective AYUSH services through upgraded AYUSH hospitals and dispensaries.
 
 
 
• **Ayurveda Day:**
 
 
• The first **Ayurveda Day** was celebrated in **2016**.
 
• It is observed to create awareness about the **health benefits** of Ayurveda and to reduce the burden of disease and related morbidity.
 
• The date of celebration varies each year as it follows the **Hindu lunar calendar**, falling on **Dhanteras**.
 
 
 
• **Global Significance:**
 
 
• India, through the **Ministry of AYUSH**, has collaborated with the **World Health Organization (WHO)** to establish the **Global Centre for Traditional Medicine (GCTM)** in **Jamnagar, Gujarat**.
 
• This initiative aims to harness the potential of traditional medicine from across the world through modern **science** and **technology**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Lord Dhanwantari:** In Hindu mythology, **Lord Dhanwantari** is worshipped as the **God of Medicine** and an avatar of Lord Vishnu, who emerged during the **Samudra Manthan** (churning of the ocean) with the nectar of immortality (Amrit).
 
• **Ministry of Education:** Primarily responsible for **school education**, **literacy**, and **higher education** in India. It does not handle traditional medicine awards.
 
• **Ministry of Culture:** Focuses on the preservation and promotion of **art**, **culture**, and **heritage**, including museums and monuments.
 
• **Ministry of Tribal Affairs:** Focuses on the **socio-economic development** of **Scheduled Tribes (STs)** through various schemes like the **Eklavya Model Residential Schools**.
 
• The **National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Award** is specifically tailored for those who have dedicated **20 years** or more to the service of Ayurveda, ensuring only veteran experts receive this high distinction.
